plain.text: "Help, LORD, for no one is faithful anymore; those who are loyal have vanished." Everyone lies to their neighbour; they flatter with their lips but are deceitful in their hearts. They say, "By our tongues we will win; our own lips will defend us. Who is lord over us?"

"Because the poor are plundered and the needy groan, I will now arise," says the LORD. "I will protect them." The words of the LORD are pure, like silver refined seven times in a furnace. God will keep the needy safe from this generation, even when the wicked strut around and what is evil is praised.

summary.bigIdea: In a world full of lies, God's words are pure and true, and he promises to protect the poor and needy.
points: The psalmist feels surrounded by flattery and lies.
God says, "For the cause of the oppressed and for the groaning of the needy, I will now arise."
"The words of the LORD are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace."
summary.reflection: In a world of spin and flattery, where do you go to hear what is true?
